title: Proactive regression containment policy engine for phased variant rollouts
creator: Maya Patel
description: Build a policy engine that automatically contains quality regressions during phased model/config rollouts (canary and A/B). The engine will evaluate multi-metric signals from evals and live traffic cohorts, enforce configurable gates (absolute and relative thresholds, trend windows), and trigger automated containment actions: immediate rollback, traffic quarantining to previous version, or traffic throttling with partial exposure. The goal is to minimize customer-facing regressions while preserving rollout velocity for safe model flips.
acceptance_criteria: Engine ingests eval and live metrics streams (latency, defect-rate, hallucination-score, token-accuracy) for canary and A/B cohorts
Support for composite gate rules (e.g., (latency increase > 2x AND hallucination rate delta > 0.8%) within 30m) with per-customer overrides
Automatic rollback action that pins traffic back to last-green model and emits audit event with provenance and diff of metrics
Canary ramp orchestration supports staged increases and interruption by policy engine with <30s decision latency
Dashboard view and alerting hook in Console showing gate evaluations, reasons for rollback, and links to artifact provenance
End-to-end test harness and a chaos test scenario that simulates a quality regression and verifies automated containment
comments: 2025-02-11 - Kickoff: aligned with Product and Observability on required signals. Identified core metrics and initial thresholds. Action matrix drafted.
2025-02-18 - Prototype: ingestion lambda for eval signals completed; live-sampler for cohort traffic telemetry in PR #470. Temporary feature flag added to Console for visibility.
2025-02-24 - Design review with Security: confirmed audit log format and minimal data retention. Security requested explicit opt-in for PII-bearing prompts (handled by downstream redaction service).

2025-02-28 - Trade-offs discussion: evaluated strict rollback vs. graduated throttling. Decided to support both with rule priority ordering; default policy favors immediate rollback for high-severity customer-impact regressions and throttling for non-blocking regressions.

2025-03-03 - QA plan: integration tests plus a synthetic regression harness that can flip a model to a degraded variant. Infra team requested a safe sandbox for chaos tests to avoid noisy metrics in production.
2025-03-05 - Blocker noted: currently missing a low-latency decision path for high-throughput canaries on Dedicated clusters. Follow-up ENG ticket raised for runtime hook (ENG-99612).
